Delivery Dash — Game Design Document

Working Title

Delivery Dash

Current Status

In Development — Prototype Phase

  • Core driving mechanics: ✅ Implemented and playable
  • Procedural city generation: 🟡 MVP working, needs district variety
  • Traffic AI: 🟡 Basic behaviors working, needs personality types
  • Delivery routing system: 🟡 Functional, needs efficiency scoring
  • Campaign levels: ⏳ 0/20 designed
  • Vehicle progression: ⏳ Design complete, not implemented
  • Daily challenge backend: ⏳ Not started

Blockers: None critical. Art/VFX pipeline needed for visual feedback on drift/boost.
